info.title: Womblex API
info.description: The Womblex service API (`womblex serve`), described as it is. Bearer tokens are service tokens from the client registry (`WOMBLEX_API_CLIENTS`); each operation names the scope it requires (`read`, `submit`, `read_raw` or `admin`). See docs/service-api.md.

get.description: `WomblexConfig`'s JSON Schema; ``paths`` is the deployment's and is left out.

schema.title: Response Get Schema V1 Config Schema Get

post.description: The config as a YAML file `womblex run --config` reads; 422 with the validation errors otherwise.
Save or replace a preset; 400 on an unsafe name or a config that would not load.

delete.description: 404 when no saved preset has *name*; a built-in is code and is never deleted.

get.description: The workflow's inbound events, newest first, owner-scoped: another owner's workflow is 404.
The store, ingest location, queue and Isaacus deployment, read without a network call.
The documents *stage* wrote a sidecar row for; 400 for a stage with no sidecar of its own.
`verify-shards`' cross-batch structural audit of the run's extraction shards.

schema.title: Response Get Audit V1 Runs  Run Id  Audit Get

get.description: The document's chunks, entities, PII spans, narrative money and quality rows.

One log as text (``?download=true`` names it as a file).

A name that is not a log's and an absent log give the same 404 with the
logs there are, so the route cannot probe outside the run's ``logs/``.
Each stage's checkpoint, read from the run itself, so it answers without a queue too.
What a submission naming *input_prefix* would run, before it is submitted.

CollectionAction.title: CollectionAction
CollectionAction.description: Which workflow to act through; needed only when several feed the collection.

CollectionDetail.title: CollectionDetail
CollectionDetail.description: A collection: the stored workflows that feed it, its document count and the workflows its files record.

ConfigValidation.title: ConfigValidation
ConfigValidation.description: Whether a posted config builds a `WomblexConfig`, with Pydantic's own errors.

DocumentDetail.title: DocumentDetail
DocumentDetail.description: One document's chunks and the rows each stage annotated on them (raw text: ``read_raw``).

DocumentText.title: DocumentText
DocumentText.description: One document's text in one layer; ``rows`` carry that layer's columns.

InboundEventOut.title: InboundEventOut
InboundEventOut.description: One inbound event: the sender's id, and the outcome it was given (null while it is being handled).

IngestPreview.title: IngestPreview
IngestPreview.description: What ``POST /v1/runs`` would pick up under ``input_prefix``; ``error`` says why it would not.

PresetOut.title: PresetOut
PresetOut.description: A named partial config; ``source`` is ``builtin`` (code, never deleted) or ``saved``.

PresetSave.title: PresetSave
PresetSave.description: A preset to save; ``dataset`` and ``paths`` in ``config`` are dropped (a preset is an overlay).

QueueSnapshot.title: QueueSnapshot
QueueSnapshot.description: The queue in one read, scoped to the caller's runs (and to ``run_id`` when given).

Resources.title: Resources
Resources.description: What the deployment is wired to, credentials masked.

RunFile.title: RunFile
RunFile.description: One object under the run. Contract keys are null for a non-Parquet or pre-contract file.

RunLogs.title: RunLogs
RunLogs.description: The run's batch logs, newest first; empty for a run written before logs were published.

RunRequest.title: RunRequest
RunRequest.description: A run submission. ``preset`` or ``config`` picks the downstream stages; neither is extraction only.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description:
One run's queue rollup. ``state`` is derived from ``counts``; ``orphaned`` marks extraction
a failed firing queued with no stages dispatched. ``summary`` is the status sentence the CLI
shows, built from the exact per-stage counts.

StageGraph.title: StageGraph
StageGraph.description: The pipeline's nodes (one per stage, plus ``extract``) and its required-input edges.

StagePresence.title: StagePresence
StagePresence.description: The documents with a row in the stage's sidecar.

StageProgress.title: StageProgress
StageProgress.description: Each stage's checkpoint for the run, in pipeline order; a stage that has not run is absent.

StoredRun.title: StoredRun
StoredRun.description: A run the store holds; ``document_count`` is null before any manifest landed.

UploadAccepted.title: UploadAccepted
UploadAccepted.description: Stored documents; ``input_prefix`` is what ``POST /v1/runs`` takes to run them.

bearerAuth.description: A service token from the client registry.

hookSignature.name: X-Womblex-Signature
hookSignature.description: `sha256=<hex>`: HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body under the hook's secret.
